concept.hr: Stanja kroz koja socket prolazi, uživo: svaka strana ima svoje
concept.en: The states a socket passes through, live: each end has its own

summary.hr: Klijent A i poslužitelj B otvaraju i zatvaraju vezu; dijagram stanja iz RFC 9293 pokazuje gdje je koja strana. Upravljaj objema stranama sam.
summary.en: Client A and server B open and close a connection; the RFC 9293 state diagram shows where each end is. Drive both ends yourself.
